scope: school_r3, TT 1.8V 27C fixed acquisition, 350ohm per sensor leg

calibration.scope: No ADC codes, noise, averaging or quantization. This is analog DC curvature diagnosis only, not full-chain calibration acceptance.

adc_differential_range_exceeded.consequence: Actual ADC clipping cannot be undone by linear calibration; no ADC conversion is simulated here.

power.scope: DC front end only, including VCM net supply. Control/source stimulus power reported separately; no ADC, periodic switching or complete chip-core power claim.

P.method: (intermediate minus summing voltage) / negative sum of actual NMOS and PMOS drain currents

N.method: (intermediate minus summing voltage) / negative sum of actual NMOS and PMOS drain currents

feedback_switch_static_diagnosis.interpretation: Opposite leg trends cancel part of the first-order signal dependence. Correlation with residual curvature is not exclusive causal attribution; resistors and amplifier operating points also vary. No PVT was run.
